title: pm-dispatch: a claim's `Container & model:` line can only be spelled with a model identifier, which objectui's AGENTS.md bans in comments — two rules conflict on every governed sister-repo claim
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a conflict between two live rules, with named sites — SKILL.md's own instruction: 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡;⛔ 不当场改文本了结」. Filed by the `domain:skills` seat 1 (`session_01KTZmMfzVzjNvyaLyQ8mHvg`, seat post #7623) from the at-tier review of PR objectui#11317 (its ③ item 9). ⛔ Filed bare for the lane's grading. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The two rules

- **objectstack, the claim template** (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` 认领 + `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` `readContainerModelLine` / `containerModelRefusal`): a `Claim:` comment carries a `Container & model:` line whose `model:` value is read by regex and judged against `ceilingTierSpellings()`; `post-stamped.mjs` refuses a claim the recognisers cannot read. Every accepted spelling of the tier is a model identifier (the marketing word or the model id).
- **objectui, `AGENTS.md`** (the quoted 「**Commit message:**」 rule, maintainer ruling A on objectui#9441): "no model identifier lands in a PR title or body, a comment, a changeset, a doc or a code comment" — two exemptions, neither covering a seat's protocol line.

## Measured

- The seat's claims on objectui#11183 (5923347428) and objectui#11011 (5923408921) carry `model: fable` and the model id in the `Container & model:` line, as the template requires; the review of PR objectui#11317 named this as the seat's exposure under objectui's rule.
- No model-free spelling exists that the recogniser accepts as the ceiling tier: `ceilingTierSpellings()` is the set it compares against, and a claim naming no tier is refused as a half-state.

## Direction (for the lane; none is a ruling)

- Add one model-free spelling to the ceiling set — the constant's NAME (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`), which the `## Contract review` record already uses in its `Served-tier:` line — and teach the claim template to use it on governed sister repos (objectui, cloud) where the comment rule applies. The recogniser then reads the tier without a model identifier landing in the comment.
- Or widen objectui's exemption list to the PM protocol's keyed lines. That is objectui's governed `AGENTS.md`, a human's approval; the first route lives entirely in `scripts/pm/**` + the skill text.
- Pin: a claim spelled `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` reads as the ceiling with its mandate cited; a claim spelled with the model id still reads (no retroactive refusal of the existing claims).

Dedupe: `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues?labels=domain:skills&state=all&per_page=100` (the 100 most recent lane cards) grepped for `model identifier`, `Container & model`, `model-free`, `ceilingTierSpellings`: 0 hits before this card. Dedupe words: `Container & model model identifier objectui AGENTS.md` · `ceilingTierSpellings model-free spelling` · `sister-repo claim comment rule conflict`.
